newsitem.title: KENYA: Ehtiopian Airlines flight hijacked - official.
newsitem.headline: Ehtiopian Airlines flight hijacked - official.

text.p: Hijackers seized control of an Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 767 on Saturday with about 178 passengers and crew on board, the state airline's general manager, Ahmed Kellow, told Reuters.
"It was flying to West Africa and had just left Addis Ababa", the Ethiopian capital, he said by telephone.
"We have very little knowledge of who the hijackers are or their demands," Kellow said.
"News reached us at about 11.40 our time (0840 GMT). The aircraft is still flying and the last we knew it has been around Dar es Salaam," he said, referring to the capital of Tanzania.
The flight was hijacked between Addis Ababa and its first scheduled stop at Nairobi, the Kenyan capital, Kellow said,

The hijacked flight appeared to be ET961, scheduled to leave Addis Ababa at 1045 a.m. (0745GMT) and making three stops in Nairobi, Brazzaville, and Lagos before arriving in Abidjan, Ivory Coast on Saturday evening.
Ethiopian Airlines is the only airline that crosses the breadth of Africa. It has one of the best safety records among African carriers.
